query:
SELECT
                a.ecosystem AS "ecosystem!",
                a.name      AS "name!",
                a.version   AS "version!",
                a.unreadable,
                s.name      AS "script?",
                s.body      AS "body?"
            FROM artifact_analysis a
            LEFT JOIN artifact_install_script s ON s.analysis_id = a.id
            WHERE a.digest = $1 AND a.reader = $2
            ORDER BY s.ordinal
